name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for ramp installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for ramp installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for exterior entry ramp installation, consider their experience with similar projects, their licensing and insurance, and their knowledge of local building codes and accessibility standards (e.g., ADA). Look for transparent communication, detailed estimates, and positive client references. A reputable contractor will also offer a thorough site assessment and be able to advise on the best materials and design for your specific needs and property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on their experience, licensing, insurance, knowledge of local codes, communication, and client references.
